checkpoint: P4 DeFMI hybrid governance and genesis integration
source_match: Every recorded source input matches the isolated worktrees.
changes: DeFMI governance nodes carry common KeyRecord metadata and independent hybrid signing handles. Key identity/generation, suite, purpose, validity, revocation, participant binding, threshold, epoch and chain domain are committed by the enrolled committee digest. Both key components must be unique across members.

Governance signatures bind the member identity, committee digest, chain domain, parent state root and complete operation statement. The RPC requires the closed suite and committee digest, and rejects classical-only or malformed signatures before state changes.

The consensus entry and allocation preview bind the authoritative block timestamp. Native SQLite execution and client preflight use an explicit host clock. No request can supply the verifier clock; unset consensus verification time fails closed.

QOMM bootstrap/acceptance, OCLOB canonical settlement/private admission, DeFMI harnesses, native bridges and the Aethel application host carry the hybrid approvals. Corporate read-only bridges now have an explicit authorizer that cannot sign or verify governance approvals.

Genesis wire version 2 carries canonical bounded key records, rejects old magic/classical keys/trailing or noncanonical bytes, and validates member key lifetimes. The public development genesis generator uses independently labeled public fixture seeds and never represents production provisioning.

Deterministic negative tests reject incomplete/corrupt components, substituted committee or epoch, wrong domain/root/statement, duplicate or insufficient signers, omitted suite, wrong key metadata, expiry and premature use. Actual VM and SQLite rejection leaves the complete state/root unchanged; replay remains closed.

verification.checks: Full DeFMI core/VM release regression tests, OCLOB node/settlement, QOMM library and four real binaries, and the full Aethel workspace. All affected targets passed warnings-denied Clippy. The DeFMI harness and all five real QOMM application binaries were also checked. Formatting passed.
verification.evidence_limits: Ordinary deterministic cryptographic and state-machine tests. No new MP-SPDZ run, seven-operator deployment, live Avalanche acceptance, WAN or latency study. Classical proof/receipt/participant tests remain regression evidence, not post-quantum evidence.

remaining: P4 is incomplete: participant, provider, guarantor/CSD and receipt signatures, cross-domain finality certificates and governance/clearing rotation propagation still need migration.

The new genesis requires explicit operator enrollment and chain rollout. Existing legacy chains are not automatically converted. SQLite authorizer configuration remains an operator trust boundary; approved enrollment/rotation of an existing ledger and durable production key provisioning are not implemented by this checkpoint.
Expired governance authorizations cannot initiate new execution. Archived acceptance recovery across key retirement and outstanding cross-domain obligations requires the P6 lifecycle work.

P1 note/opening confidentiality, TLS certificate authentication and WAN measurement; P2 reserve compatibility paths; P3 encrypted holder custody and legacy KYB; P5 hash-based public audit proofs and P6 retirement/recovery remain open.
FROST, Pedersen binding, anonymous/nullifier proofs and the remaining direct classical signatures are not post-quantum. No full system claim, ledger deletion, push, main merge or deployment.

genesis_artifact.verification: The real qomm-avalanche-vm CLI consumed the generated JSON and emitted QOMMGEN2 bytes. The checked-in public development config is byte-identical to that tested input. No existing chain or ledger was reset.
